# Open Adventurer

This public starter is a deliberately generic level-one Human Fighter with the Soldier background.
Sylvia replaces the display name with the name entered during campaign setup. It has no authored
history, relationships, personality, or personal decisions; Customize is the path for supplying
those choices.

The starter uses the standard array, assigning Strength 15, Dexterity 14, Constitution 13, Wisdom
12, Intelligence 10, and Charisma 8 before its Soldier increases. Soldier adds 2 to Strength and 1
to Constitution, producing Strength 17 and Constitution 14. Its Fighter skills are Perception and
Insight. Soldier grants Athletics, Intimidation, Savage Attacker, and proficiency with dice gaming
sets. Human Skillful grants Survival. Human Versatile takes the recommended Skilled feat, granting
Acrobatics, Stealth, and Persuasion. Human Resourceful is part of the character, although this
Ruleset does not automate Heroic Inspiration.

The Fighter takes the recommended Defense Fighting Style and masters the Greatsword, Flail, and
Spear. Defense is represented in its Armor Class of 17 while it wears Chain Mail; Fighting Style and
Savage Attacker behavior are not otherwise automated.

It takes Fighter equipment package A and Soldier equipment package A: Chain Mail, Greatsword, Flail,
8 Javelins, a Dungeoneer's Pack, Spear, Shortbow, 20 Arrows, dice gaming set, Healer's Kit, Quiver,
Traveler's Clothes, and 18 GP in total. The current engine tracks the 20 Arrows in ammunition. It
has no currency field, so the 18 GP is preserved here rather than presented as an engine-owned
balance.
